scope: 31 UI design deliverables including 1 existing gameplay screen and 30 new screens/state boards

tasks.title: 开始界面
tasks.brief: 16:9 start screen at a bright Daoist island fishing harbor. Restrained title 捕鱼; same fishing apprentice on the right, open sea and jade-roof pavilions. Primary 开始游戏; secondary 公告 and 设置. No other branding, no credentials form.

tasks.title: 加载界面
tasks.brief: 16:9 loading screen with a panoramic bright underwater-to-island vignette, familiar fish and gourd cannon. Title 正在进入渔场; jade/gold progress bar 68%; short tip 合理使用锁定，可优先捕捉目标鱼. Calm composition and lower loading area.

tasks.title: 游戏大厅
tasks.brief: 16:9 game lobby with bright immortal seaside harbor. Compact top resource strip 金币 12,800 / 灵玉 120, player 见习渔师. Four central polished illustrated destination cards 浅海渔场 / 珊瑚海域 / 深海秘境 / 龙宫宝境, last card 未解锁. Bottom navigation 炮台 / 图鉴 / 背包 / 任务 / 商城 / 好友; corner 邮件 and 设置. Clear hierarchy.

tasks.title: 渔场选择
tasks.brief: 16:9 room selection window titled 渔场选择. Left region tabs 浅海 / 珊瑚 / 深海 / 龙宫; three illustrated room rows named 悠游浅湾 / 碧波沙洲 / 流光珊瑚 with clear availability 空闲 / 热闹 / 未解锁. Right preview miniature seascape, concise 推荐炮台 3级 and 进入渔场 primary button. Values are visual examples.

tasks.title: 捕鱼主界面
tasks.brief: reuse designs/ui/fishing-main-v1/fishing-main-v1.png

tasks.title: 炮台选择
tasks.brief: 16:9 cannon collection window 炮台. Left illustrated grid of six distinct jade/ivory/gold Daoist cannons, including familiar 葫芦炮, 云纹炮, 莲华炮; selected tile jade rim, two locked silhouettes. Right large selected gourd cannon view, name 葫芦炮, status 已装备, primary 装备 and secondary 升级. Bottom simple page control.

tasks.title: 炮台升级
tasks.brief: 16:9 cannon upgrade window 炮台升级. Large gourd cannon left on quiet jade pedestal, central before/after panels 3级 → 4级. Right concise stat rows 威力 120 → 145 and 效率 8 → 10, material slots 灵玉碎片 12/20 and 铜钱 8,000. Primary 升级 with clear missing-material small label 材料不足, secondary 获取材料. Distinguish current value green and required amount red; values demonstration.

tasks.title: 技能面板
tasks.brief: 16:9 skills window 技能. Six readable illustrated spell icons in left grid for 冰封 / 雷网 / 聚鱼 / 追踪 / 护持 / 激流, selected 冰封. Right large ice/jade talisman illustration, short effect line 短暂减缓鱼群移动, cooldown 冷却 30秒. Bottom two equipped skill slots, primary 装备技能. Restrained no overwhelming effects.

tasks.title: 鱼类图鉴
tasks.brief: 16:9 fish encyclopedia 图鉴. Top tabs 全部 / 常见 / 珍稀 / 传说 and completion 已收集 12/36. Twelve illustrated fish cards in a tidy 4x3 grid, selected red-gold 灵锦鲤, other named short examples 青鳍鱼 / 金尾鱼 / 云纹龟 with silhouettes for undiscovered. Right compact selected fish preview and 查看详情 action. No repeated identical fish.

tasks.title: 鱼类详情
tasks.brief: 16:9 fish detail window 灵锦鲤. One large expressive red-gold chibi koi in an oval aqua illustration area left. Right clear ivory information with category 珍稀, habitat 珊瑚海域, captured 已捕获 8次, three star icons; short line 尾鳍如云，灵光随行. Bottom collection progress and primary 前往渔场; secondary 返回图鉴.

tasks.title: 背包
tasks.brief: 16:9 bag window 背包. Top tabs 全部 / 道具 / 材料. Left 5x4 well-spaced inventory cells with about ten distinct icons: ice talisman, jade shard, net charm, key, treasure shell, gold purse; quantities. Selected 冰封符 tile. Right selected icon, name 冰封符, brief 使用后释放一次冰封效果, 数量 5, primary 使用 and secondary 获取. Clear empty slots.

tasks.title: 道具使用
tasks.brief: 16:9 view of a focused 使用道具 modal over softly dimmed bag. Large ice talisman icon, name 冰封符, concise 数量选择, minus / 1 / plus with 最大 secondary. Availability 持有 5. Primary 确认使用 and secondary 取消. One well-proportioned popup, excellent readable typography.

tasks.title: 每日任务
tasks.brief: 16:9 task window 任务. Tabs 每日 / 每周. Four spaced task rows 捕鱼达人 / 初试炮台 / 探索海域 / 收集材料; progress 8/10, 1/1, 0/1, 3/5; visually distinct 去完成 / 领取 / 已领取 states. Each row has compact reward icons. Bottom jade progress bar 今日活跃 60/100 and three milestone chests, primary 一键领取.

tasks.title: 成就
tasks.brief: 16:9 achievement window 成就. Left category tabs 捕鱼 / 收集 / 成长. Right three generous achievement rows 初入渔海, 锦鲤知音, 炮台匠心 with medal icons, short progress 10/10, 8/20, 3/5 and reward icons. One 领取, one 进行中, one 已领取. Top 总成就 120 and overall progress. No tiny long paragraphs.

tasks.title: 每日签到
tasks.brief: 16:9 daily sign-in window 每日签到. Seven large reward cards arranged 4 top +3 bottom with meaningful icons and labels 第1天 through 第7天; last day ornate chest, past days checkmarks, current 第3天 jade selected. Side small fishing apprentice illustration and 本月已签到 3天. Primary 签到领取, secondary 补签. No invented month calendar.

tasks.title: 活动中心
tasks.brief: 16:9 event center 活动. Left vertical event tabs 灵海寻宝 / 七日有礼 / 渔获挑战. Right large original lantern-and-koi painted banner for 灵海寻宝 with concise subtitle 探索海域，收集灵贝, two reward cards and a 清楚的 查看活动 primary action. Use warm festive accents sparingly; no copied old mail event or dates.

tasks.title: 活动详情
tasks.brief: 16:9 event detail 灵海寻宝. Left illustrated route of five shell treasure milestones around a subtle seascape; completed first two jade checks, third current, last ornate chest. Right concise objective 收集灵贝 12/20, rewards icons, one progress bar and 前往捕鱼 / 领取奖励 buttons. A short 规则 link, no long unreadable rule blocks.

tasks.title: 商城
tasks.brief: 16:9 shop 商城 using only game currencies. Left categories 道具 / 材料 / 外观. Six product cards in 3x2 grid: 冰封符 / 雷网符 / 灵玉碎片 / 铜钥匙 / 云纹炮饰 / 灵贝礼盒. Distinct polished icons, small currency price, simple 购买 buttons. Top 金币 12,800 and 灵玉 120. No real-money symbols or invented payment channels.

tasks.title: 购买确认
tasks.brief: 16:9 focused 购买确认 popup over softly dimmed shop. Large 冰封符 icon; quantity minus 1 plus, total 总计 200 金币 and balance 持有 12,800. Primary 确认购买 and secondary 取消; close X. One clean well-sized modal; strictly in-game currency.

tasks.title: 邮件
tasks.brief: 16:9 fishing mail window 邮件. Follow approved mail reference panel hierarchy but use original fishing content. Left four rows 渔场奖励 / 系统通知 / 每日补给 / 活动回馈, one unread dot and selected first row. Right title 渔场奖励, sender 灵海驿站, short body 道友辛苦了，请收下今日渔获奖励, three distinct attachment icons with quantities. Actions 一键领取 / 领取附件 / 删除. No old event title or reference sender.

tasks.title: 好友
tasks.brief: 16:9 friends window 好友. Tabs 好友 / 申请 / 查找. Left three original chibi portrait rows named 渔舟客 / 青荷 / 云帆, status 在线 / 捕鱼中 / 离线, distinct faces and outfits. Right selected friend profile with jade portrait frame, concise scene 浅海渔场 and actions 邀请同游 / 查看资料. Bottom 添加好友. No guild or team lists copied from reference.

tasks.title: 排行榜
tasks.brief: 16:9 leaderboard 排行榜. Tabs 渔获 / 收藏 / 成长. Left ranked list of five rows with first three tasteful medals, distinct portraits and short names 渔舟客 / 青荷 / 云帆 / 海棠 / 见习渔师 and sample values; own row softly jade highlighted. Right modest winner portrait display and concise 本周渔获 18,600. Footer 我的排名 5, small cycle label 本周榜. No excessive gold or gambling jackpot language.

tasks.title: 个人资料
tasks.brief: 16:9 player profile 个人资料. Left full-body familiar fishing apprentice, matching existing character image if provided. Right ivory dossier: 见习渔师, 等级 8, jade experience bar, 当前炮台 葫芦炮, four compact badges and sample statistics 捕鱼次数 128 / 图鉴收集 12. Primary 更换头像 and secondary 编辑昵称. No copied reference character name/level.

tasks.title: 设置
tasks.brief: 16:9 settings window 设置. Left tabs 音画 / 操作 / 其他. Main panel sliders 音乐 / 音效, toggles 震动 / 特效, quality selector 画面质量 with 标准 / 高清 and 高清 selected. Simple lock-target assist 操作辅助. Bottom 恢复默认 secondary, 保存设置 primary. Gold jade knobs, clear on/off states.

tasks.title: 玩法说明
tasks.brief: 16:9 help window 玩法说明. Left tabs 基础操作 / 炮台技能 / 鱼类图鉴. Main three generous illustrated instruction cards: 点击发射 with cannon icon, 锁定目标 with reticle icon, 使用技能 with ice talisman icon; concise one-line readable explanations. Bottom step indicator 1/3 and 下一页. Artwork supports clear instruction, not dense documentation.

tasks.title: 渔获结算
tasks.brief: 16:9 session result window 渔获结算 over a dimmed shallow sea. Center elegant ivory jade/gold panel, title with gentle cloud flourish. Three large statistics 本次渔获 36 / 获得金币 2,800 / 图鉴新增 2, six compact fish catch icons with quantities, rewards coin pouch and jade shard. Bottom 返回大厅 secondary and 继续捕鱼 primary. No victory/defeat battle labels.

tasks.title: 奖励领取
tasks.brief: 16:9 single polished 获得奖励 popup over gently dimmed jade sea background. Three generous reward items 铜钱 ×2,000 / 灵玉碎片 ×5 / 冰封符 ×1 each crisp icon, subtle warm gold glow contained behind panel. Primary 领取 / secondary 查看背包. No excessive sparkles or casinos.

tasks.title: 捕鱼操作状态
tasks.brief: 16:9 art design sheet of FOUR equally sized gameplay overlay previews in a clean 2x2 composition, each showing the same jade sea gameplay language. Headers 自动捕鱼 / 目标锁定 / 技能冷却 / 暂停. Auto shows selected 自动 button, lock shows reticle on koi and selected 锁定, cooldown shows ice icon with 12秒, pause shows focused modal 继续捕鱼 / 返回大厅. Each state independently readable. This is a deliberate UI state sheet, not a full-screen game collage.

tasks.title: 确认与网络弹窗
tasks.brief: 16:9 UI state sheet, four generous ivory/jade/gold dialogs in clean 2x2 on a very subdued jade sea background, each with generous quiet space. Top left 退出渔场: 本次渔获已保存, buttons 继续捕鱼 / 返回大厅. Top right 金币不足: 可前往领取每日补给, buttons 去领取 / 取消. Bottom left 连接中断: 正在尝试重新连接, spinner and 重新连接 / 返回大厅. Bottom right 操作确认: 是否使用此道具, buttons 确认 / 取消. Shared consistent primary/secondary style; readable Chinese. No personal data or real payment info.

tasks.title: 空白加载异常状态
tasks.brief: 16:9 UI state sheet with four generous full window excerpts on quiet ivory/jade, clear 2x2 grid and enough gap. 邮件为空: cute sealed fish/cloud envelope, 暂无邮件. 好友为空: two small jade fish charms, 暂无好友, 添加好友. 数据加载: jade swirl progress/spinner, 正在加载. 获取失败: subdued cloud-scroll icon, 暂时无法获取数据, 重试. Match exact UI family and avoid dramatic warning colors. No lorem ipsum.

tasks.title: 通用控件规范图
tasks.brief: 16:9 native hand-painted component design board titled 通用控件, orderly generous grid on warm ivory silk paper. Show same jade/gold rounded buttons for 主按钮 / 次按钮 / 禁用 / 选中, top tabs 全部 / 道具 / 材料 with first selected, three toggles showing on/off/disabled, checkbox checked/unchecked, jade progress bar 60%, five inventory slots normal/selected/locked/empty, a polished title plaque 标题 and circular 关闭 icon. Main state labels concise and readable. Consistent exact materials, borders and scale family. Art specification board, no code or implementation labels.
